scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter starter-app build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter "@picots/webview" build && bun run --filter "@picots/core" build && bun run --filter "@picots/vite-plugin" build && bun run --filter "@picots/cli" build && bun run --filter "@picots/create" build
scripts.test:pack: bun run build:packages && cd packages/core && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../webview && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../vite-plugin && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../picots && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../create-picots && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:publish: bun run build:packages && cd packages/core && npm publish --access public && cd ../webview && npm publish --access public && cd ../vite-plugin && npm publish --access public && cd ../picots && npm publish --access public && cd ../create-picots && npm publish --access public
